# mibz2

> A bzip2 decoder built for memory-level parallelism.

mibz2 is a bzip2 decoder, block-parallel, its inverse BWT walked as interleaved chains
within each block, with byte-for-byte libbzip2 output and every block and stream CRC
checked, from Python (`mibz2.decompress`, `mibz2.open`) or Rust (`mibz2::decode`,
`mibz2::BzReader`). Install with `pip install mibz2` or `cargo add mibz2`. Each link below
is the Markdown version of a page of https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/.

## Benchmarks

- [Benchmarks](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/benchmarks/index.md>): How mibz2's CI benchmark measures the decoder: the corpora, the rounds, the paired ratios and the modelled full-dump figure.
- [History](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/benchmarks/history/index.md>): mibz2's decoding speed, CPU time and peak memory over master's commits, per corpus and thread count.
- [Alternatives](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/benchmarks/alternatives/index.md>): mibz2 beside other bzip2 decoders on master's latest benchmark run: paired ratios with 95% intervals, per corpus and thread count.

## Concepts

- [Concepts](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/concepts/index.md>): What mibz2 decodes, what it checks, and how it decodes in parallel.
- [Why 32 couriers beat one](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/concepts/couriers/index.md>): mibz2's premise, memory-level parallelism in the inverse BWT, explained through couriers and a dispatcher: independent lanes, prefetching, the per-step cost that binds next, and the measurements.
- [What is checked, and when](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/concepts/checks/index.md>): Which CRCs mibz2 checks and when, what its errors report, and the inputs it refuses.
- [How it works](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/concepts/how-it-works/index.md>): mibz2's scanner thread, its workers, and the inverse BWT walked as interleaved chains.
- [Prior work](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/concepts/prior-work/index.md>): The work mibz2 builds on: libbzip2's format and checks, Kärkkäinen, Kempa and Puglisi's interleaved BWT inversion, and lbzip2's and pbzip2's block parallelism.

## Get started

- [Installation](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/getting-started/installation/index.md>): Install mibz2 from PyPI or crates.io.
- [Quickstart](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/getting-started/quickstart/index.md>): Decode a .bz2 file with mibz2 from Python and from Rust.

## Optional

- [History](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/background/history/index.md>): Where mibz2 came from: written in wikidata-pq to decode the Wikidata dump, then moved to a repository of its own.
- [Journals](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/background/journals/index.md>): mibz2's development journals: where they are and what each one records.
- [Development](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/maintainers/development/index.md>): The repository's layout, how to build, test and benchmark mibz2, and the commit conventions.
- [Documentation](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/maintainers/documentation/index.md>): How the documentation site and its benchmark pages are built, checked, tested and published to GitHub Pages.
- [Releasing](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/maintainers/releasing/index.md>): How mibz2 is released to crates.io and PyPI at one version: Deploy Release, Tag Release and Release Notes.

## Reference

- [Reference](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/reference/index.md>): mibz2's API in Python and in Rust.
- [mibz2 (Python)](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/reference/api/mibz2/index.md>): The mibz2 Python package: decompress, open, BZ2Reader and DecodeError.
- [mibz2 (Rust)](<https://lmmx.github.io/mibz2/pr-preview/pr-44/reference/rust/index.md>): The mibz2 Rust crate: decode, decode_parallel, BzReader, StreamDecoder, scan, decode_blocks and Error.
